answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 24742 Country: India Title: Allah blessed me with a daugther one of my friend suggest me her neme is "Dia" please advise me is this name is correct according to Shria or not. Question: Assalamualekum, Allah blessed me with a daugther one of my friend suggest me her neme is "Dia" please advise me is this name is correct according to Shria or not. Answer ID: 24742 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1309/961/L=1431) Dia (دیا) is not a good name. It would be better if you choose one from any of these names: Ayesha, Hafsa, Maryam, Khadija, Khunsa, Fatimah, Kulsum, Zainab, Aasiya etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
